svg.text: Each box is a subworkflow, each row a step (top to bottom). The green line is the VCFs; every other input line merges into the step that uses it.
Reference genome (FASTA): feeds the steps that use it (dashed)
VCFs of all technologies: the central line to the results
GIAB (--giab_<name>) and other stratification BEDs, repeat regions
VEP cache or GTF (--vep): consequences, genes
Known variants (--known_variants): required checklist, truth sets
